DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 五センチくらいの長さを残すご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Mga limang sentimetro po ang gustong iwang haba?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 違います。今から五センチ切るつもりでした。残す長さではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切る量と残す長さの誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi po. Limang sentimetro ang puputulin mula ngayon, hindi ang maiiwan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itama ang pinagputol at natitirang haba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切る量と仕上がりを分けて確認しましょう。まだ切っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ihiwalay natin ang putol at resulta. Hindi pa natin pinuputol.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今の長さからどこまでになるか、鏡で示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未切断で仕上がり位置を鏡で求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Salamat po. Maaari bang ituro sa salamin kung hanggang saan mula sa haba ngayon?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng final position sa salamin bago gupitin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この位置が目安です。前髪も同じ量を切るご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Dito ang tantiya. Pareho rin ang bawas sa bangs?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前髪は別です。全て五センチではなく、前髪の形を見て相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前髪を別条件として相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Iba po ang bangs. Hindi lahat limang sentimetro; titingnan ang hugis at pag-uusapan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang bangs bilang hiwalay na kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの仕上がりを示します。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 示された所を確認します。髪を結べるかも、切る前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認した位置で結べる希望も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Titiyakin ko po ang itinuro. Gusto ko ring itanong bago gupitin kung maitatali pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagnanais magtali sa natiyak na haba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 仕上がりと普段の使い方を合わせて考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Isaalang-alang ang resulta at pang-araw-araw na gamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では後ろと前髪の位置を確認し、結ぶ希望も含めて合意してから切ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部位と用途の合意後に切るよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tiyakin po ang likod at bangs pati pagtali; kapag nagkasundo saka gupitin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hilinging gupitin matapos magkasundo sa bahagi at gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その確認が済んでから始めます。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲み物の追加注文は、この時刻で終了です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Dito na nagtatapos ang additional drink orders.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 席も同時に終わると思いました。料理が残っていますが、すぐ出る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飲物注文終了で即退店か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Akala ko po kasabay ang upuan. May pagkain pa; kailangan bang lumabas agad?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung aalis agad sa end of drink orders. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文できる時間と席の案内は別です。ご予約の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang order time at seat conditions. Titiyakin ang reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つを同じ時刻と読んでいました。席の利用終了と退店の手順を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 席利用終了と退店手順を別に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po pareho ang oras. Pakituro ang seat end at exit procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hiwalay itanong ang seat end at exit steps. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材の席の案内はこちらです。飲み物は追加できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang seat guide sa materyal na ito. Hindi na magdadagdag ng inumin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 席が続くから飲み物も延長されたとは考えません。残っている料理を食べられる時間を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 席継続を飲物延長と扱わず食事時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping na-extend ang drink dahil may upuan pa. Titiyakin ang oras ng pagkain sa natira.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag ituring na drink extension ang seat continuation at tiyakin ang meal time. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認した時間内でご利用ください。追加の有料注文も条件を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Gamitin sa natiyak na oras. Itanong din ang kondisyon ng dagdag na paid order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は追加しません。同行者へ二つの時間を説明し、席の案内に合わせて片付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加せず同行者へ二時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Wala muna pong dagdag. Ipapaliwanag sa kasama ang dalawang oras at magliligpit ayon sa seat guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag magdagdag at ipaalam ang dalawang oras. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計方法も、終わる前に確認できます。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。飲み物終了と席の終了を分けて伝え、案内された手順で会計して出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件に合わせて会計退店を行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Hiwalay ipapaalam ang drink end at seat end at susundin ang bayad at paglabas.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magbayad at lumabas ayon sa kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では席の条件と会計をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang seat conditions at bill.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この五個の検査結果を報告してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Iulat ang inspection result ng limang ito.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傷とへこみがあったので、不良品は二個と書きました。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二種類の不具合を不良品二個と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.translation: May gasgas at yupi po kaya dalawang defective ang isinulat ko.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat bilang dalawang defective ang dalawang uri ng depekto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 傷とへこみは、同じ部品にありましたか。それぞれ別の部品ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Parehong piyesa ba ang may gasgas at yupi o magkaiba?

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ一個です。不具合の種類を二つ見つけたので、部品の数も二個にしていました。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ部品で種類数と個数を混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Isang piyesa po. Dalawang uri ang nakita kaya dalawa rin ang isinulat na bilang.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang parehong piyesa at paghahalo ng uri at bilang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 部品の個数と不具合の内訳を分けて、実物と記録を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ihiwalay ang dami ng piyesa at depekto at tingnan ang aktuwal at tala.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この番号の一個に傷とへこみがあります。残りの四個の結果とは分けて示します。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 該当部品番号と二種類を残り四個から分け示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Isang may numerong ito po ang may gasgas at yupi. Hiwalay ipapakita sa resulta ng apat.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang ID at dalawang depekto nang hiwalay sa apat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録の訂正方法も確認します。すでに二個として次の担当へ報告しましたか。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin din ang correction. Naipasa na bang dalawa sa kasunod?

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ渡していません。二個と書いた表を黙って渡さず、訂正する箇所を担当と確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未引継ぎを伝え表の訂正を担当と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi pa po. Hindi basta iaabot ang maling table; sabay titingnan ang correction.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa naipasa at tiyakin sa staff ang correction. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 判定基準は別に照合します。不具合が見えることだけで、処分まで決めないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay ang judgment criteria. Huwag pasya hanggang disposal dahil may nakikitang depekto.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。一個に二種類を見つけた事実を報告し、集計の訂正と判定を確認してから引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個数訂正と判定を分け処分を自己決定せず引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Iuulat ang isang may dalawang uri, titiyakin ang tally correction at judgment, saka ipapasa.
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang count correction at judgment at huwag sariling magpasya ng disposal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その一個と集計表をこちらへ示してください。一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-OTA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipakita ang isang iyon at tally sheet. Sabay tingnan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の車についてご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四人で大きいケースを四つ持ちます。この写真の荷室なら、全部積めると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四人と四ケースの予定を荷室写真で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Apat po kami at apat na malaking case. Akala ko kasya lahat sa cargo photo na ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong gamit ang cargo photo para sa apat at apat na case. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その写真では後席を倒しています。四人が座る状態の荷室とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nakatiklop ang likod na upuan sa photo. Iba sa cargo kapag may apat na nakaupo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四人乗る条件を見落としていました。席を倒さない状態で荷物の相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 倒した後席と四人乗車の条件差を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko po napansin ang apat. Gusto kong itanong ang luggage nang hindi tinutupi ang seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kilalanin ang pagkakaiba ng folded seat at apat na sakay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の寸法と人数で、担当が車の候補を確認します。ケースの大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang titingin sa sasakyan ayon sa sukat at tao. Alam ang case size?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 寸法のメモがあります。荷物を座席に置いて一人の席をなくす方法は希望しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物寸法を示し乗員席を荷物で減らさない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: May sukat po. Ayokong alisin ang upuan ng isa para lagyan ng luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang sukat at huwag bawasan ang passenger seat para sa gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四人の乗車と荷物を両方条件として確認します。車の変更は料金と空き状況の説明が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Parehong apat na sakay at luggage ang kondisyon. Kailangan ang presyo at availability para sa pagpapalit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の予約を先に取り消さず、変更候補と追加料金を聞いてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既存予約を維持して候補と料金説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po kakanselahin muna ang dati; gusto kong marinig ang candidates at dagdag bago magpasya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang reservation at humiling ng candidates at bayad. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が案内します。写真だけで積載できると確約した扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng staff. Hindi photo lang ang garantiya ng cargo capacity.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。四人分の席を使う条件と荷物寸法を示し、説明後に予約をどうするか伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数と寸法を条件に説明後の予約判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Apat na upuan at sukat ang ipapakita; pagkatapos sasabihin ang gagawin sa booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang reservation decision matapos ang paliwanag batay sa tao at sukat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その条件で候補を確認します。現在の予約情報もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin ang candidates sa kondisyong iyan. Dalhin ang reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの品をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へ買いたいです。何かの食材を避けていたので、野菜だけならよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の不明確な食物制限で野菜を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Para po sa kaibigan. May iniiwasang sangkap kaya akala ko gulay lang ay ayos.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagpili ng gulay sa hindi tiyak na food restriction ng kaibigan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 避ける必要のある内容が分からないまま、野菜料理ならよいとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi masasabing ayos ang gulay nang hindi alam ang kailangang iwasan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何を避けるか本人に聞いていませんでした。先に友人へ確認するので、まだ注文しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人未確認を認め連絡まで注文を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko po naitanong. Kokontakin muna siya kaya huwag umorder.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Amining hindi pa natiyak at ihinto ang order hanggang contact. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お返事の内容に合わせて、材料や調理条件は担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ayon sa sagot, matitiyak sa staff ang sangkap at pagluluto.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人から返事が来ました。本人の説明を省略せずに担当へ伝え、対応を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の返答を省かず担当へ伝えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sumagot na po. Gusto kong ipasa ang buong paliwanag niya nang walang bawas at tiyakin ang tugon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging ibigay sa staff ang buong sagot ng tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当を呼びます。料理の説明を聞いて、友人にも確認してから選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tatawagin ang staff. Maaari kayong pumili matapos ang paliwanag at pagtiyak din sa kaibigan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私だけで大丈夫と返事せず、説明された条件をそのまま友人へ伝えます。了承前には買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店の説明を本人へ伝え了承前に購入しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi po ako mag-isang sasagot na ayos. Eksaktong kondisyon ang sasabihin sa kaibigan at hindi bibili bago pumayag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipasa ang store explanation at huwag bumili bago pahintulot ng tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応が難しい場合もあります。その際は無理に代わりの料理を決める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Maaaring hindi kaya. Hindi kailangang piliting pumili ng kapalit kung ganoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。条件を確認できなければ、今日は料理の土産をやめると友人に伝えます。まず担当の説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件が確認できなければ土産をやめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Kung hindi matiyak, sasabihin kong walang food souvenir ngayon. Hihintayin muna ang staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang food souvenir kapag hindi matiyak ang kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人から確認した内容を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Sabihin sa staff ang natiyak mismo sa kanya.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 組立についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ねじが二本残っています。全部使わないと完成ではないと思い、どこかへ足そうとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残ったねじを全部追加すべきと思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: May dalawang screw pong natira. Akala ko hindi tapos hangga't hindi lahat kaya idaragdag ko sana saanman.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pag-aakalang dapat idagdag ang lahat ng natira. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残った部品には予備の場合もあります。説明書の部品一覧と工程を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaaring spare ang natira. Tingnan ang parts list at steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ足していません。袋の本数だけで判断せず、説明書と使った本数を見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未追加と伝え部品一覧と使用本数の照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko pa po idinagdag. Hindi bilang sa supot lang; pakitugma ang manual at nagamit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang dagdag at humiling ng list at used-count match. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一覧では予備の欄が別です。どの工程まで進めたかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hiwalay ang spare sa list. Tingnan rin kung hanggang saang hakbang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最後の図まで進めましたが、固定の確認はまだです。ねじが余っただけで完成とも言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最終工程まで進めたが固定未確認と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa huling larawan na po pero hindi pa checked ang pagkakakapit. Hindi rin ko tatawaging tapos dahil may natira lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang huling hakbang ngunit hindi pa checked ang fixing. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が説明書に沿って確認点を案内します。指定のない場所へ穴を増やさないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ituturo ang check points ayon sa manual. Huwag gumawa ng bagong butas na walang utos.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 穴は増やしません。予備の二本は分けて保管し、指定された確認箇所を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定外の穴を増やさず予備を別保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Wala pong dagdag na butas. Ihihiwalay ang dalawang spare at rerepasuhin ang designated checks.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag dagdagan ang butas at itabi nang hiwalay ang spare. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真で分からない箇所は追加の確認が必要です。使う前に不明点を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: May hindi matitiyak sa photo na kailangan pa ng check. Ayusin ang tanong bago gamitin.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。予備の存在と組立の確認は別にし、確認できていない状態では使わず、担当へ相談を続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予備と完成確認を分け不明点解消まで使用を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Ihiwalay ang spare at completion check; hindi gagamitin habang hindi tiyak at patuloy kukonsulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang spare at completion at huwag gamitin hanggang malinaw. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では説明書の工程番号で確認します。残ったねじもそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tingnan ayon sa step number. Dalhin pati ang natirang screw.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが応募先への紹介状です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ito ang referral letter sa employer.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これをもらえたので、家族には採用が決まったと伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紹介状で採用決定を家族に伝えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dahil nakuha ko po, maaari bang sabihing hired na sa pamilya?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung hiring confirmed ang referral letter. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紹介状の発行と、応募先の採用決定は違います。これからの選考の案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang referral at hiring decision. Tingnan ang susunod na screening.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事が決まった通知ではなかったのですね。面接の日時は、この紙だけで確定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 採用と区別し面接日程の確定状況を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala hiring notice. Tiyak na ba sa papel lang ang interview date?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay sa hiring at itanong ang interview confirmation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では応募先と日程の確認が必要です。連絡方法はこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito, kailangang tiyakin sa employer. Narito ang contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に日程を確認します。今の職場へ退職日を伝える根拠として、この紹介状だけを使わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 応募先に日程確認し紹介状だけで退職判断をしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Schedule muna po. Hindi ko gagawing dahilan itong referral lang para magsabi ng resignation date sa kasalukuyang trabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang employer schedule at huwag magpasya ng resignation sa referral lang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 応募に必要な書類も確認してください。紹介状とは別に準備する物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin din ang application documents. May hiwalay sa referral.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 履歴書はまだ準備中です。紹介状が出たので応募書類も全部そろった、と考えず準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 履歴書未準備と申告し別書類をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Inihahanda pa po ang resume. Hindi iisiping kumpleto ang application dahil may referral.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing resume ay inihahanda pa at kumpletuhin ang hiwalay na dokumento. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない点があれば、連絡前に質問を整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kung may tanong, ayusin bago tumawag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族には応募の紹介を受けた段階と伝え、書類と日程を確認して選考へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族へ応募段階と説明し書類日程確認後に進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat po. Sa pamilya ay referral stage ang sasabihin, at dokumento at schedule muna bago screening.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa pamilya ang application stage at magpatuloy matapos ang dokumento at schedule. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この連絡方法と必要書類の案内をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dalhin ang contact at required-document guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 得点表示についてのお尋ねですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人のレーンで一回投げました。自分の画面には入っていないので、点を足してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣レーンで投げた得点を自分へ追加したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Minsan po akong bumato sa lane ng kaibigan. Wala sa akin; maaari bang idagdag ang puntos?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Magtanong tungkol sa pagdagdag sa sarili ng puntos sa katabing lane. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのレーンで、誰の順番に投げたか確認が必要です。自分の記録へそのまま加えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tiyakin ang lane at kaninong turno. Hindi direktang idaragdag sa sarili.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人の名前が出た時に投げました。自分の順番を隣へ移せると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の順番で投げたことと誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pangalan po niya ang nakalabas. Akala ko maililipat ang turno ko sa katabi.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na sa turno ng kaibigan bumato at ang maling akala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つのレーンの進行を係が確認します。いったん次の投球を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang titingin sa dalawa. Huwag munang bumato ulit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待ちます。友人にも自分の投球だったと伝え、さらに点を直そうとして操作しないよう頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 投球を止め友人にも勝手な記録操作を止めてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Maghihintay po. Sasabihin sa kaibigan na akin ang tira at huwag siyang mag-operate para itama pa ang score.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihinto ang tira at hilingin sa kaibigan na huwag sariling baguhin ang record. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係が記録を確認して、案内できる対応を説明します。手入力で元に戻せるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titingnan ang record at ipapaliwanag ang magagawa. Hindi tiyak na maibabalik sa manual input.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 点だけを移すのではなく、友人の順番と自分の残りの順番をどう扱うか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 得点移動だけでなく双方の順番の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi puntos lang ang ililipat; gusto kong malaman ang turno niya at natitira ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang turno ng dalawa at hindi score move lamang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が説明します。両方のレーン番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng staff. Ano ang lane numbers?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらが六番、友人が七番です。二つの番号と投げた時の名前を伝え、案内後に再開します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両レーン番号と表示名を伝え確認後に再開する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Anim po ako at pito siya. Ibibigay ang dalawa at pangalang nakalabas, saka magpapatuloy pagkatapos ng gabay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang dalawang lane at display name at magpatuloy matapos matiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報で確認します。今は両方の次の投球をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Gamit iyon ang pagtiyak. Parehong huwag munang tumira.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのラジオをご検討ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電池が入っているので、店で動作を確かめた物だと思いました。家でもそのまま使えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電池入りを動作確認済みと考えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: May battery po kaya akala ko tested sa tindahan. Magagamit ko na sa bahay nang ganoon, ano?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang tested dahil may battery. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 電池が入っていることと、動作確認の記録は別です。商品札の確認範囲を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang battery at testing record. Tingnan ang check scope sa product tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電池の存在だけで判断していました。電源だけでなく、音を受信できたかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電源と受信の確認範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Battery lang po ang pinagbatayan. Gusto kong malaman hindi lang power kundi reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang power at reception check scope. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が記録を調べます。店内で受信を試せる条件も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ang record at kondisyon ng in-store reception test.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で札を外して操作せず、担当の案内で試します。古い電池が商品に含まれるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無断操作せず案内で試し電池付属を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po aalisin ang tag at patatakbuhin; susundin ang staff. Kasama rin ba ang lumang battery?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag walang pahintulot na paandarin at itanong ang battery inclusion. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電池の扱いと、保証の対象は別に案内します。確認前に両方付くとは決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hiwalay ang battery at warranty. Huwag ipalagay na pareho ang kasama bago matiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 試用、電池の付属、保証の三つを分けて聞きます。動かなければ電池を替えるだけで直るとも思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 試用付属保証を分け電池交換で修復を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Testing, battery at warranty po ang tatlo. Hindi rin iisiping battery change lang ang lunas kung ayaw gumana.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang trial, accessory at warranty at huwag tiyaking maaayos sa battery. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が来ました。記録と商品を一緒にご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Narito na ang staff. Sabay tingnan ang record at produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。受信の確認範囲と付属品、保証の説明を聞いてから、購入するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三つの説明を聞いてから購入を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat po. Reception check scope, accessories at warranty muna, saka magpapasya kung bibili.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasya matapos ang tatlong paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順にご説明します。現状の電池は、確認前に取り出さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sunod ipapaliwanag. Huwag muna alisin ang battery.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申告のどの点を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Anong bahagi po ng filing ang tatanungin?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この控えに受付とあります。今年も提出済みだと思うので、確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付控えを今年の提出済み証拠として確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: May received sa kopyang ito. Akala ko filed na ngayong taon; maaari bang tingnan?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipasuri ang receipt copy bilang patunay ng filing ngayong taon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの対象年と受付日時を確認しましょう。どの申告で受け取った物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan ang tax year at received timestamp. Saang filing nakuha?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前年の申告の物でした。今年の書類と同じ袋へ入れていたので取り違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えが前年で同袋保管による取り違いと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nakaraang taon po pala. Kasama ng ngayong taon sa supot kaya napagpalit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang lumang taon at same-bag mix-up. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今回の申告について、入力や送信の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: May input o sent record ngayong taon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入力途中の画面はありますが、送信完了の記録は見つかりません。前年の控えを今年の証拠として使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今年は入力画面だけで完了記録未発見と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: May in-progress screen pero walang completion record na makita. Hindi ko gagamitin ang lumang kopya bilang ebidensiya ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing screen lang at walang nakitang completion ngayong taon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の状態は、対象年を含めて担当が確認します。重ねて送信する前に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff ang titingin pati taon. Tiyakin bago magsend uli.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。未提出と自分で決めて再送することもせず、今年の画面と前年の控えを別に示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未提出断定と再送を避け年別に資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Hindi ko rin sariling ipagpapalagay na hindi naipasa at uulitin; hiwalay ang bagong screen at lumang kopya.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iwasan ang not-filed assumption at resubmission at ipakita ayon sa taon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認に必要な資料を案内します。締切についてのご相談もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ituturo ang kailangan. May tanong din sa deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今年の対象と期限も確認したいです。受付状態が分かってから、必要な手順を担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今年の期限と受付状態確認後の手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Gusto ko pong malaman ang sakop at deadline ngayon. Pagkatapos ng received-status check, itatanong ang kailangan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itanong ang taon, deadline at steps matapos ang status check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二つの年の資料を分けたまま、今年の状態から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-OTA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Panatilihing hiwalay ang dalawang taon at kasalukuyan muna ang titingnan.
